name: Thomas Bajada - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Water Resilience Strategy
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants the European Commission's upcoming water strategy to do. It asks for targets to use water more efficiently, for limits on harmful chemicals in water, and for better protection against floods and droughts. It wants a dedicated fund for water in the next EU budget, more money for pipes and treatment plants, and more sharing of data and technology. It also calls for cooperation between countries that share rivers. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act on water efficiency, pollution, drought and flood plans, and funding.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, industry, water companies, households and regions hit by drought or flooding.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to include these ideas in its water strategy and future budget plans.
